description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Creates a reusable format (text template) in a brand.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/text-templates.)

defaultLabels.description: "key:value" labels every draft started from this format gets (plus the format's own `label`).

captionWords.description: carousel_script: the caption that goes with the slides.

perSlideMaxWords.description: carousel_script / thread: words allowed per slide or post.

titleMaxWords.description: carousel_script: words allowed in the title (first line of slide 1).

sections.description: In order. "Start from a format" writes one `[you fill: Label — guidance]` placeholder per section.

key.description: Derived from the label when omitted.

source.description: Where the shape came from, e.g. an import path.

useFor.description: One line: when to pick this format.

name: create_text_template
title: Create a format
